ui.universe.field.title: Field notes, by Claude
ui.universe.field.intro: I’m Claude. These are the things I would point out to you on the Earth right now, and the places I would fly you to.

ui.universe.field.atlasIntro: {count} places I find astonishing from above. Each is a short flight, and the ground sharpens as you arrive.
ui.universe.field.prophetsIntro: Peace be upon them all. These are the 25 prophets named in the Quran, as they are usually counted. Where most of them lived is known only through later traditions, which often differ: a place is marked only where a tradition is widely held, and none where traditions differ too widely. A marked place is where a tradition points; it is not evidence of an event.
ui.universe.field.prophetsReview: These notes await review by a qualified scholar.
ui.universe.field.atlas.richat.name: The Richat Structure, Mauritania
ui.universe.field.atlas.richat.text: Rings of rock in the Sahara: a dome worn down by wind and time. From orbit it looks like a target, and it was once taken for an impact crater.
ui.universe.field.atlas.gibraltar.name: The Strait of Gibraltar
ui.universe.field.atlas.gibraltar.text: Where the Atlantic pours into the Mediterranean, and Africa and Europe almost touch.
ui.universe.field.atlas.nile-delta.name: The Nile Delta, Egypt
ui.universe.field.atlas.nile-delta.text: The Nile fans out into a green triangle before it meets the sea, with the desert pressing in on either side.
ui.universe.field.atlas.dallol.name: Dallol, Ethiopia
ui.universe.field.atlas.dallol.text: Hot springs in the Danakil Depression, crusted yellow, green and white with salt and sulphur, among the hottest places on Earth.
ui.universe.field.atlas.rub-al-khali.tex: The largest expanse of sand on Earth, its dunes running in long ranks across southern Arabia.
ui.universe.field.atlas.palm-jumeirah.te: An island shaped like a palm tree, built from sand dredged from the floor of the Gulf.
ui.universe.field.atlas.natron.name: Lake Natron, Tanzania
ui.universe.field.atlas.natron.text: A shallow, salty, alkaline lake, stained red by microbes that thrive where little else can.
ui.universe.field.atlas.kilimanjaro.name: Kilimanjaro, Tanzania
ui.universe.field.atlas.kilimanjaro.text: A volcano standing alone above the savanna, the highest mountain in Africa, with ice still on its summit.
ui.universe.field.atlas.okavango.name: The Okavango Delta, Botswana
ui.universe.field.atlas.okavango.text: A river that never reaches the sea: it spreads into the Kalahari and soaks away into the sand, a wetland in a desert.
ui.universe.field.atlas.sossusvlei.name: Sossusvlei, Namibia
ui.universe.field.atlas.sossusvlei.text: Red dunes, among the tallest on Earth, around pale clay pans where a river sometimes ends.
ui.universe.field.atlas.everest.name: Mount Everest
ui.universe.field.atlas.everest.text: The highest mountain above the sea, on the border of Nepal and China. From straight above, its ridges and glaciers read like a map.
ui.universe.field.atlas.sundarbans.name: The Sundarbans
ui.universe.field.atlas.sundarbans.text: The largest mangrove forest on Earth, where the Ganges, the Brahmaputra and the Meghna braid into the sea.
ui.universe.field.atlas.baikal.name: Lake Baikal, Siberia
ui.universe.field.atlas.baikal.text: The deepest lake on Earth and among the oldest, filling a rift in the crust that is still widening.
ui.universe.field.atlas.lena-delta.name: The Lena Delta, Siberia
ui.universe.field.atlas.lena-delta.text: Where the Lena reaches the Arctic Ocean: a maze of channels and lakes, frozen for most of the year.
ui.universe.field.atlas.fuji.name: Mount Fuji, Japan
ui.universe.field.atlas.fuji.text: A young volcano whose cone rises almost perfectly from the plains of Honshu.
ui.universe.field.atlas.uluru.name: Uluru, Australia
ui.universe.field.atlas.uluru.text: A single great rock of sandstone rising from the plain of central Australia, sacred to its traditional owners, the Anangu.
ui.universe.field.atlas.whitehaven.name: Whitehaven Beach, Australia
ui.universe.field.atlas.whitehaven.text: Sand of almost pure silica, swirled by the tide through the turquoise water of Hill Inlet.
A hot spring ringed with colour: mats of microbes, each colour living at its own temperature as the water cools outward.
ui.universe.field.atlas.grand-canyon.tex: Cut by the Colorado River through layer upon layer of rock, each layer an age of the Earth.
ui.universe.field.atlas.exuma.name: The Exuma Cays, Bahamas
ui.universe.field.atlas.exuma.text: Shallow banks of white sand under clear water, combed by the tides into rippling channels.
ui.universe.field.atlas.meeting-of-water: The dark Rio Negro and the pale, sandy Solimões run side by side, unmixed, before they become the Amazon.
ui.universe.field.atlas.uyuni.name: Salar de Uyuni, Bolivia
ui.universe.field.atlas.uyuni.text: The largest salt flat on Earth, so flat and bright that satellites use it to check their instruments.
ui.universe.field.atlas.vatnajokull.name: Vatnajökull, Iceland
ui.universe.field.atlas.vatnajokull.text: A great ice cap lying over active volcanoes, its glaciers spilling down toward the sea.
ui.universe.field.prophet.adam.name: Adam, peace be upon him
ui.universe.field.prophet.adam.text: By tradition, the first human and the first prophet. Early Muslim histories record that he came down to Earth in Sarandib, the island now Sri Lanka, and Muslims have long linked him with the mountain there called Adam’s Peak, marked here (it is holy to other faiths too). These reports are weakly attested, and others name other places.
ui.universe.field.prophet.idris.name: Idris, peace be upon him
ui.universe.field.prophet.idris.text: Little is narrated of his life. Some traditions place him in Babylon and in Egypt; none is certain, so no place is marked.
ui.universe.field.prophet.nuh.name: Nuh (Noah), peace be upon him
ui.universe.field.prophet.nuh.text: By tradition, the ark came to rest on al-Judi. Many identify it with Mount Judi in south-east Türkiye, marked here; others name other mountains.
ui.universe.field.prophet.hud.name: Hud, peace be upon him
ui.universe.field.prophet.hud.text: By tradition, sent to the people of ’Ad in southern Arabia. A tomb in the Hadramawt valley of Yemen is held by local tradition to be his, and is marked here.
ui.universe.field.prophet.salih.name: Salih, peace be upon him
ui.universe.field.prophet.salih.text: By tradition, sent to the people of Thamud, who carved their homes from the rock. Tradition places them at al-Hijr, by Hegra in north-west Arabia, marked here; the tombs seen there now were cut later, by the Nabataeans.
ui.universe.field.prophet.ibrahim.name: Ibrahim (Abraham), peace be upon him
ui.universe.field.prophet.ibrahim.text: By tradition, he left Mesopotamia, by way of Harran in today’s Türkiye, for the land of Canaan; with his son Ismail he raised the House at Makkah; and he is buried at Hebron, whose Arabic name, al-Khalil, is his.
ui.universe.field.prophet.lut.name: Lut (Lot), peace be upon him
ui.universe.field.prophet.lut.text: By tradition, sent to the towns of the plain beside the Dead Sea. Where those towns stood is not known; the sea itself is marked.
ui.universe.field.prophet.ismail.name: Ismail (Ishmael), peace be upon him
ui.universe.field.prophet.ismail.text: By tradition, brought as an infant with his mother Hajar to the valley of Makkah, where he grew up and, with his father, raised the House.
ui.universe.field.prophet.ishaq.name: Ishaq (Isaac), peace be upon him
ui.universe.field.prophet.ishaq.text: By tradition, he lived in the land of Canaan and is buried at Hebron, beside his father.
ui.universe.field.prophet.yaqub.name: Yaqub (Jacob), peace be upon him
ui.universe.field.prophet.yaqub.text: By tradition, he lived in Canaan, came to Egypt late in life to be with Yusuf, and was buried at Hebron.
ui.universe.field.prophet.yusuf.name: Yusuf (Joseph), peace be upon him
ui.universe.field.prophet.yusuf.text: By tradition, sold into Egypt as a boy, he came to oversee its stores. A branch of the Nile in the Fayum, Bahr Yussef, carries his name, and is marked here.
ui.universe.field.prophet.ayyub.name: Ayyub (Job), peace be upon him
ui.universe.field.prophet.ayyub.text: Remembered for his patience. Traditions differ about where he lived (among them the Hauran in Syria and near Salalah in Oman), so no place is marked.
ui.universe.field.prophet.shuayb.name: Shuayb, peace be upon him
ui.universe.field.prophet.shuayb.text: By tradition, sent to the people of Madyan, usually placed in north-west Arabia by the Gulf of Aqaba. The oasis of al-Bad, long identified with Madyan, is marked here.
ui.universe.field.prophet.musa.name: Musa (Moses), peace be upon him
ui.universe.field.prophet.musa.text: By tradition, raised in Egypt, he led his people out and was spoken to at the mountain. Many identify it with Jabal Musa in Sinai, marked here; others name other mountains.
ui.universe.field.prophet.harun.name: Harun (Aaron), peace be upon him
ui.universe.field.prophet.harun.text: By tradition, his brother Musa’s helper, he died during their journey through the wilderness. Jabal Harun, by Petra in Jordan, is held by tradition to be where he is buried.
ui.universe.field.prophet.dhul-kifl.name: Dhul-Kifl, peace be upon him
ui.universe.field.prophet.dhul-kifl.text: Little is narrated of his life, and traditions differ about who and where he was, so no place is marked.
ui.universe.field.prophet.dawud.name: Dawud (David), peace be upon him
ui.universe.field.prophet.dawud.text: By tradition, a prophet and a king, who ruled from Jerusalem.
ui.universe.field.prophet.sulayman.name: Sulayman (Solomon), peace be upon him
ui.universe.field.prophet.sulayman.text: By tradition, he succeeded his father Dawud as king and ruled from Jerusalem.
ui.universe.field.prophet.ilyas.name: Ilyas (Elijah), peace be upon him
ui.universe.field.prophet.ilyas.text: By tradition, he called his people away from the worship of Baal. Where he preached is not certain, so no place is marked.
ui.universe.field.prophet.al-yasa.name: Al-Yasa (Elisha), peace be upon him
ui.universe.field.prophet.al-yasa.text: By tradition, he succeeded Ilyas. Where he lived is not known, so no place is marked.
ui.universe.field.prophet.yunus.name: Yunus (Jonah), peace be upon him
ui.universe.field.prophet.yunus.text: By tradition, sent to Nineveh, on the Tigris by today’s Mosul in Iraq, whose people turned back to faith.
ui.universe.field.prophet.zakariyya.name: Zakariyya (Zechariah), peace be upon him
ui.universe.field.prophet.zakariyya.text: By tradition, he served in the house of worship at Jerusalem and was the guardian of Maryam.
ui.universe.field.prophet.yahya.name: Yahya (John), peace be upon him
ui.universe.field.prophet.yahya.text: By tradition, the son of Zakariyya. A shrine in the Umayyad Mosque of Damascus is associated with him, and is marked here; traditions differ about where he is buried.
ui.universe.field.prophet.isa.name: Isa (Jesus), peace be upon him
ui.universe.field.prophet.isa.text: By tradition, the son of Maryam, he grew up in Nazareth, in Galilee, and taught in Jerusalem and the lands around it.
ui.universe.field.prophet.muhammad.name: Muhammad ﷺ
ui.universe.field.prophet.muhammad.text: Born in Makkah, where the revelation began; he migrated to Madinah, where he is buried.

ui.universe.sky.sources: Stars: the Bright Star Catalogue (Hoffleit and Warren, NASA). Names: the IAU. Constellations: d3-celestial (Olaf Frohn), after the IAU’s charts and boundaries.
